title: Unknown visits
description: The visits that nothing is known of — no day, no camera, no card — to a location in a revision before its first known visit. They count as visits to finish a revision, but nothing can be checked against them. A real visit that comes later takes the place of its unknown one.
x-rules: Only for a revision before the first known visit of the location.

location_id.description: The location as it was said, when it is not one of the project's.
